summary.en: US stocks closed higher on Monday, with the S&P 500 rising 0.7% to 7,676.77, the Nasdaq Composite up 0.82% to 26,169.38 and the Dow Jones Industrial Average adding 0.28% to 52,361.58. Sentiment in artificial intelligence stocks was lifted after Anthropic filed for an initial public offering, disclosing steep losses alongside rapid revenue growth, and the Philadelphia semiconductor index rose 2.8%. Tesla jumped 5.2% after a Barclays upgrade, while Meta fell 1.9% after saying it plans to raise up to 95 billion US dollars in equity for its AI build-out. The 10-year Treasury yield held at 5.00% ahead of the Federal Reserve's decision on Wednesday, with markets pricing only a 12.7% chance of a rate rise.

summary.en: Senior officials from Iran, Pakistan, Saudi Arabia and Türkiye have concluded a high-level meeting in Tehran aimed at reducing regional tensions and preventing a renewed escalation of the conflict involving Iran, the United States and Israel. According to a joint statement issued after the meeting on Monday, the four countries agreed to continue dialogue to strengthen regional cooperation, peace and security, though no date or venue for the next meeting was announced. The talks at Tehran's Saadabad Palace brought together Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian, Saudi Defence Minister Prince Khalid bin Salman, Pakistan's army chief Field Marshal Asim Munir and Turkish intelligence chief Ibrahim Kalin. Pezeshkian departed for Moscow on Monday evening to attend a gas exporters' summit and hold talks with Russian President Vladimir Putin.
summary.zh_hans: 伊朗、巴基斯坦、沙特阿拉伯及土耳其的高级官员在德黑兰完成高层会谈，旨在缓和地区紧张局势，防止涉及伊朗、美国及以色列的冲突再度升级。根据会后发表的联合声明，四国同意继续对话，加强地区合作、和平与安全，但未公布下次会谈的日期及地点。会谈在德黑兰萨达巴德宫举行，与会者包括伊朗总统佩泽希齐扬、沙特国防大臣哈立德亲王、巴基斯坦陆军参谋长穆尼尔元帅及土耳其情报首长卡林。佩泽希齐扬星期一傍晚启程前往莫斯科，出席天然气出口国论坛峰会，并与俄罗斯总统普京会谈。
summary.zh_hant: 伊朗、巴基斯坦、沙特阿拉伯及土耳其的高級官員在德黑蘭完成高層會談，旨在緩和地區緊張局勢，防止涉及伊朗、美國及以色列的衝突再度升級。根據會後發表的聯合聲明，四國同意繼續對話，加強地區合作、和平與安全，但未公布下次會談的日期及地點。會談在德黑蘭薩達巴德宮舉行，與會者包括伊朗總統佩澤希齊揚、沙特國防大臣哈立德親王、巴基斯坦陸軍參謀長穆尼爾元帥及土耳其情報首長卡林。佩澤希齊揚星期一傍晚啟程前往莫斯科，出席天然氣出口國論壇峰會，並與俄羅斯總統普京會談。

title.en: Iran, Pakistan, Saudi Arabia and Türkiye agree to continue regional security talks after Tehran meeting
